name: Rayong/ U-Tapao Rayong Pattaya International Airport

runway.v: one runway, 18/36, 3,505 m long and 60 m wide
runway.quote: Runway 18 ... 3505 m x 60 m; Runway 36 ... 3505 m x 60 m

slots.v: Level 2 (schedule facilitated) airport: CAAT facilitates schedules and non-scheduled flights must obtain a slot
slots.quote: UTP/VTBU | Rayong/ U-Tapao Rayong Pattaya International Airport | Facilitation | CAAT; Applicants requesting approval for non-scheduled flight permission must obtain slots for Level 2 and Level 3 Airport.

permits.v: non-scheduled flights (including private flights) need a flight permit from CAAT's Flight Permit Division, applied for at least 3 business days ahead through the online system (FPOS)
permits.quote: The application must be submitted to the Flight Permit Division at least three (3) business days in advance
